findings.reason: the enumeration is the node's specification for what `close` reports, and one guard the same transition fires is missing from it, so the mechanism as written need not produce the done-when (a plan with no chain-closing outcome) and the section's stated completeness is wrong.
findings.text: §6 states the `close` op "runs every guard a terminal transition fires and reports each one that fails, together" and lists four, but a transition to a landed status (`shipped`/`done`) also fires `continuation_present`, raising `CONTINUATION_REQUIRED` (`reckon/_store.py:3441`) — the guard §6 exists to retire — so a node wiring only the listed four leaves a close to a terminal status able to be refused by an un-reported guard, and the section never states that `close`'s `outcome` must be chain-closing for the write to land
